title: Meat Doll Workshop in Another World
description: When I woke up after dying from overwork I realized that I was in a workshop street in this new world. I, Jang Suhyeok, broke the most expensive product of this street’s best Meister Heine right after I woke up. I had to work at Aruru, her workshop as a payback… Then why am I being used as a model for adult products? Plus, the sex doll she’s working on, doesn’t it look just like me? My new life starts with master craftsman Heine who’s perfect except for her personality, and Deliah, the spirit of fire of Aruru. A craftsman is a craftsman even after he dies, and I will make everything needed. Even if it’s an adult product!
